race.comment: WEASEL SEA (6) is bursting to win, placing in five of five runs. Returned with yet another minor after racing on speed and fitter again should be in the finish. BOHEMIAN BLITZ (11) gave a sight when third on debut at Moe over 1108m, and looms as a serious contender. SOHO MISS (14) is a filly by Dirty Work who presents on the back of three jump-outs and has shown ability. Leading yard and expected to run well. HE'S ON POINT (12) is a Lindsay Smith Blue Point colt who has had plenty of education and won both jump-outs this time in work. Looks ready to hit the ground running with the assistance of an inside draw.
